breakdown.description: The simulation is for natural convection in a fluid layer heated from below (along Z-axis), but gravity is applied horizontally (in the -X direction), which will not drive the vertical buoyant instability.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly defines the gravity vector as `g (0 0 -9.81);`, which applies gravity in the -Z direction (vertically downward along the height axis). This matches the ground truth and fixes the original error where gravity was incorrectly specified in the -X direction as `g (-9.81 0 0);`.
